experiences.title: Senior Software Developer
experiences.subtitle: Onpier GmbH, Munich, Germany
workDescription: Designed and operated 10+ production-grade Spring Boot microservices for leading German insurance providers, enabling scalable, API-driven value-added services with 99.9% uptime in production environments.

Leveraged AI-assisted development tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) for solution exploration, code generation, automated test creation, code reviews, debugging, and technical documentation, significantly accelerating development while maintaining production-grade quality standards.

Led company-wide migration 25+ CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins to Tekton, cutting build times by 25%, boosting deployment success by ~30%, and fully removing manual release steps through Kubernetes-native automation.
Orchestrated containerized backend services on Kubernetes, enabling zero-downtime deployments, horizontal scaling, and stable multi-environment production operations.
Built the platform's observability layer (Micrometer/Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, latency and error-rate alerts tied to SLOs) and carry on-call for business-critical carrier integrations.
Engineered integration and Selenium-based E2E test suites with Allure reporting, covering ~75-80% of critical backend workflows and reducing regression-related production incidents by ~40%.

experiences.title: Backend Developer
experiences.subtitle: Fimo Health GmbH, Köln, Germany
workDescription: Delivered microservices-based backend systems for a digital healthcare platform supporting 1,500+ multiple sclerosis patients, ensuring scalable architecture and strict GDPR-compliant processing of sensitive medical data.
Defined and optimized backend APIs and service workflows using Java and Spring Boot, lowering average API latency by ~20% and improving overall system responsiveness.
Produced medical reporting and data visualization modules using Python (Pandas, Plotly, Flask), shortening report generation time by ~30% and accelerating clinical decision support.
Refined backend reliability by diagnosing performance bottlenecks and optimizing data access patterns across services backed by Cassandra and MongoDB.
Expanded unit test coverage to ~80% by authoring comprehensive Groovy-based test suites, significantly reducing regression defects during feature releases.
Liaised with product managers, clinicians, and frontend teams (8-10 stakeholders) in an Agile/Scrum environment, translating medical requirements into secure, production-ready backend solutions.
